tests.expectation: Create one bookmark, add to three folders; same canonical ID and shared notes visible in each.
Remove from one folder while preserving other memberships and source; delete folder without silently deleting bookmark.
Duplicate URLs with different meanings remain separate unless the user chooses to merge.
Browser import and export preserve or explicitly explain multi-membership compatibility and physical duplicate fallbacks.
Generate Editorial Project from selected gallery; existing notes become captions/text, bookmark linked to image appears directly below.
Switch to Gallery/Research template without changing canonical sources; edit headings, order and curated bookmark inclusion.
Create two projects from same source; update one without modifying the other or original notes.
Export static website offline; verify functioning links, accessible navigation, media rights and responsive layout.
Public project with private bookmark membership or attachment leaks no related counts, labels, URLs or source bytes.
AKF project and membership JSON independently parses, survives roundtrip and preserves stable identities.
Integration, staging, privacy-negative tests and production-quality user value verified before canonical manifest promotion.
